verses.html: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.text: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

verses.html: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
verses.text: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

verses.html: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
verses.text: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

verses.html: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.text: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

verses.html: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
verses.text: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

verses.html: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
verses.text: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

verses.html: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.text: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

verses.html: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.text: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

verses.html: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.text: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

verses.html: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
verses.text: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

verses.html: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
verses.text: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

verses.html: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.text: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

verses.html: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.text: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

verses.html: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
verses.text: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

verses.html: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.text: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

verses.html: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.text: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

verses.html: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.text: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

verses.html: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
verses.text: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:

verses.html: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.text: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

verses.html: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.text: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

verses.html: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.text: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

verses.html: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.text: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

verses.html: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.text: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

verses.html: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.text: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

verses.html: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verses.text: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

verses.html: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.text: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

verses.html: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.text: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

verses.html: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
verses.text: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

verses.html: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.text: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

verses.html: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.text: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

verses.html: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.text: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

verses.html: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.text: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.html: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.text: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

verses.html: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.text: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

verses.html: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
verses.text: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

verses.html: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.text: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

verses.html: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
verses.text: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

verses.html: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.text: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

verses.html: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.text: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

verses.html: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

verses.html: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.text: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

verses.html: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.text: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

verses.html: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.text: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

verses.html: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
verses.text: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

verses.html: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.text: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

verses.html: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

verses.html: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.text: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

verses.html: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.text: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.html: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
verses.text: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

verses.html: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.text: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.

verses.html: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.text: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

verses.html: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.text: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

verses.html: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

verses.html: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
verses.text: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

verses.html: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
verses.text: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.

verses.html: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.text: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

verses.html: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.text: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

verses.html: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.text: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

verses.html: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
verses.text: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

verses.html: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
verses.text: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

verses.html: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
verses.text: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;

verses.html: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.text: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

verses.html: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
verses.text: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

verses.html: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
verses.text: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

verses.html: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.text: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

verses.html: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
verses.text: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
